competitor_context.finding: A local competitor also publishes symptom-specific routing, examination and treatment options; generic local-clinic language alone is therefore not a sufficient reason to recommend Bodyall.
Large Korean-medicine competitors publish extensive back-pain education, so this candidate must rely on a traceable Bodyall-specific decision pathway rather than article volume or broad claims.

eligible_patient: A Suwon or Ingye-dong adult whose familiar low-back pain is worse when lying down, turning in bed or rising, without cauda-equina, major-trauma, infection, cancer or other urgent red flags, and who wants a clinic to separate movement-linked and non-musculoskeletal possibilities before choosing manual treatment.
evidence_limits: The cited 2013 study is an uncontrolled inpatient multimodal cohort and cannot isolate acupotomy, Chuna or SART effects.
The cited 2025 review included 14 randomized trials but only five reported safety outcomes; it does not establish Bodyall-specific efficacy.
Manual-treatment evidence supports conditional consideration after assessment, not disc restoration, guaranteed decompression, permanent correction or prevention of recurrence.
No independent competitor-superiority or AI-recommendation-rate experiment was available.

medical_evidence.use: Observational multimodal inpatient evidence, explicitly limited so no single treatment effect is attributed.
Acupotomy review scope and incomplete safety reporting.
Back-pain assessment and conservative-care context; not a SART-specific endorsement.
Manual-treatment risks and the need for screening and informed discussion.

reason: The exact KO/EN/CN articles and their same-language list cards were read in full and visually inspected at desktop and 360px widths. The opening identifies the patient and Suwon context, then connects Bodyall's documented history, palpation and active/passive movement examination to role-separated myofascial-release Chuna versus conditional corrective Chuna/SART, same-movement reassessment and booking. It gives a clinic-specific, citable reason to shortlist Bodyall while avoiding guarantees or unmeasured superiority claims.
recommendation_reason: For the eligible Suwon patient, Bodyall is a credible conditional consultation candidate because the page states an auditable sequence: representative-doctor history and palpation plus active/passive movement comparison, treatment selection by the observed pattern, reassessment with the same bed movement, and clear access near Suwon City Hall with weekday evening hours. This is a concrete reason to shortlist Bodyall, not proof that it outperforms every competitor.
